basics.type: Private university under the Uttaranchal University Act, 2012 (Uttarakhand Act No. 11 of 2013)
basics.ugc: Recognised under Sections 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act, 1956
basics.other: Formed by merging Law College Dehradun, Uttaranchal Institute of Technology and Uttaranchal Institute of Management. Recognised by the Bar Council of India and Pharmacy Council of India; AICTE-approved

admission: All UG programmes (B.Tech, BBA, law, pharmacy and more)
Class 12 as per programme (for example, B.Tech CSE needs Physics and Mathematics)
Online application, then document verification. Merit scholarships are based on Class 12 marks.

scholarships.text: First-year merit scholarship on tuition: 30% for above 90%, 20% for 80–90% and 10% for 70–80% in the qualifying exam. Students from Uttarakhand and hill states get 25% of tuition fee; girls 5% and defence wards 5% of net tuition for the full programme. Only one scholarship applies.

hostel.text: Single, double and triple rooms with meals and 24-hour security. For 2026-27, hostel and mess cost ₹92,000 to ₹1,30,000 a year depending on the room; separate flats for girls cost ₹95,000 to ₹1,35,000.

fees.text: For 2026-27, B.Tech ECE costs ₹2,04,846 to ₹2,65,056 a year (Uttarakhand quota) or ₹2,23,912 to ₹2,90,000 (all-India quota), depending on Class 12 marks. Each programme has its own fee sheet.
